subject: Request: Strategic trial rebate (28%) for MedEx Therapeutics
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Strategic trial rebate (28%) for MedEx Therapeutics

Hi Ben / Mina / Jonas,

Quick ask: MedEx (Carlos Mendez) is pushing for a deeper rebate on Hosted API usage to make this pilot economics-positive for their board. Key points:
- Scope: 6-month pilot (estimated token usage ~ $250k / month) with an earmarked expanded commit to 12 months if pilot metrics hit thresholds.
- Ask: 28% rebate off published Hosted API usage rates during the 6-month pilot; they want final pricing locked before legal signs SOW.
- Rationale: Strategic reference account in oncology software, potential multi-region expansion and marketplace co-marketing; procurement says this rebate makes the ROI model work for them.
- Risks: ~28% is above typical deal desk thresholds (>20%). Margin impact is non-trivial without a firm post-pilot commitment.

Attachments: pricing_breakdown_MedEx.xlsx (modeled P&L), SOW_MedEx_v1.pdf (pilot scope).

Proposal from my side: approve a time-limited 28% rebate for the 6-month pilot conditioned on a signed 12-month expansion addendum (TBD) and a minimum monthly committed baseline if they expand. Also require standard data & security terms and a cap on streaming concurrency to protect latency SLOs during the pilot.

If you can confirm approvals or ask for alternate guardrails, I’ll relay to Carlos and get procurement looped in.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0149

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Strategic trial rebate (28%) for MedEx Therapeutics

Priyom — thanks for the write-up and attachments. A few quick thoughts: 

1) 28% is outside our usual delegated approval for sales. Need senior sign-off (Mina) or finance OK.
2) If we approve, we should hard-limit the rebate to the pilot window only and require an explicit expansion commit (MMR or committed tokens) before extending the rate.
3) Suggest we require a short clawback clause if they don’t convert to the agreed expansion terms. Also want to see a slimmed-down forecast showing net contribution margin at 28% (I looked at your spreadsheet; can you add a column for net CPU + infra variable?).

If Mina is comfortable, I’d be willing to greenlight with the guardrails above. Jonas — please flag operational constraints (capacity / concurrency) we should add to the SOW.

-Ben
Ben Carter | Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T10:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Strategic trial rebate (28%) for MedEx Therapeutics

Agree with Ben — this is large but strategically defensible. A few concrete approvals/conditions I’m willing to sign off on: 

• Approval: provisional 28% rebate for the 6-month pilot only.
• Conditions:
  - Signed SOW for pilot + a non-binding expansion LOI that converts to a 12-month committed minimum within 30 days of pilot completion.
  - Finance sign-off on margin impact with the included clawback (partial rebate reversal if the expansion doesn’t materialize).
  - Ops constraints documented in SOW (max burst/concurrency, priority tier non-production).
  - Legal to review and approve standard data protections and audit access language.

Jonas — please confirm ops constraints we should insert (I don’t want pilot to trigger SLA slippage for paying customers).

If finance/legal sign off, I authorize the team to communicate the provisional approval to MedEx. Priyom — coordinate signature flow and get procurement included in the next email.

Mina Haddad | VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@medex.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medex.com>
Cc: procurement@medex.com, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Strategic trial rebate (28%) for MedEx Therapeutics

Carlos / Elena — thanks for your patience. Good news: Redwood can provisionally offer a 28% rebate on Hosted API usage for the 6-month pilot. Conditions (summarized):

• The 28% rebate applies to the pilot period only (6 months) and will be documented in the attached SOW.
• MedEx will sign a non-binding LOI to pursue a 12-month committed expansion within 30 days of pilot completion; expansion will include a committed monthly baseline (TBD during pilot).
• A clawback clause will be added: if expansion commitments are not met within the agreed window, a prorated portion of the rebate will be reversed.
• Operational guardrails: pilot limited to X concurrent streams and standard priority tier; Jonas Weber (cc) will confirm capacity settings and add to SOW.
• Standard data/security terms apply; legal teams to exchange redlines on the SOW.

Attached: SOW_MedEx_v1.pdf, pricing_breakdown_MedEx.xlsx

Next steps: If you confirm acceptance of the conditions, procurement can countersign the SOW and we’ll route to Legal for the usual review. We’ll also capture the expansion LOI template in HubSpot (link shared).

Looking forward — excited to get MedEx on the platform.

Best,
Priyom Das | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai
